title: Red: historical contact diagnosis, repair, and current accepted V6 execution

diagnosis.input: Current RGB pose, synchronous robot q16, and public CAD/forward kinematics
diagnosis.finding: A front-edge pinch can appear loaded but fail to retain the piece.

refinement: Two handoffs, with fresh actual RGB/q16 bindings and checks before donor withdrawal.
scope: Earlier diagnostic runs and V13 development images explain the contact repair. V13 passed all eight Red transfer windows and physical placement but ended at 82/84 checkpoints. The separate current V6 full-twelve execution passed all 84 checkpoints and terminal RGB confirmation, under four custom fixed cameras.
visual_status: Current V6 terminal RGB observations at 704.36 and 705.38 s both pass independent complete-packing interpretation. Visible material sites plus known rigid geometry determine the hidden sites; those hidden sites are inferred, not individually measured.

rounds.label: Diagnose
rounds.attempt: Earlier handoffs passed, but the held piece rolled during the follow-up motion.
rounds.diagnosis: RGB and robot kinematics placed the bead beyond the front of the blade.
rounds.change: Check the actual finite contact face throughout closing.
rounds.outcome: Saved observations explained why a loaded jaw alone was insufficient.

rounds.label: Repair
rounds.attempt: Keep the donor holding while the receiver is corrected.
rounds.diagnosis: Closing can move the far bead away from its preclose position.
rounds.change: Reopen locally, reobserve, recenter, and reclose under the same geometry checks.
rounds.outcome: The bounded recovery and contact checks passed independent API review.

rounds.label: Rejoin
rounds.attempt: Run both handoffs with fresh receiver bindings in the complete sequence.
rounds.outcome: All eight Red transfer windows and its release passed. The final physical assembly and arms-home state passed independent audit.

local_repair_review.description: Independent actual-API review of bounded preclose/recovery, with original source, terminal and full-geometry contracts retained. This review itself did not run new physics.

current_continuous_execution.terminal_explanation: All 84 original checkpoints passed, including Red final handoff and finish. Two actual terminal RGB observations at 704.36 and 705.38 s independently support the same complete rigid-CAD packing.
current_continuous_execution.terminal_RGB_scope: 41 currently labeled material sites constrain a unique complete 55-site packing; 14 occluded sites are inferred using known rigid geometry, not individually measured.
current_continuous_execution.evaluation_basis: Independent audit of saved native states and original checkpoint contracts, plus independently recomputed actual terminal RGB witnesses. Simulator diagnostics are not policy inputs.
current_continuous_execution.camera_scope: four custom fixed virtual RGB cameras; no wrist or official three-camera qualification
current_continuous_execution.display_camera_scope: Separate posthoc presentation observer; never a policy sensor.
current_continuous_execution.scope: One fresh full-twelve simulation, seed 0, layout C, four custom fixed RGB cameras. Earlier V13 images and repair clips remain historical development evidence.

narrative.title: Red: repair the receiving contact.
narrative.problem: A jaw could look loaded while holding the edge of a bead, allowing the piece to roll.
narrative.result: The V13 development run passed both Red handoffs and its physical release. The separate current V6 run passes all 84 checkpoints and terminal RGB confirmation.
narrative.scope: Historical V13 physical assembly; current V6 acceptance is documented separately.
